First 5 latin characters will be shown in physical cockpits. The entire text will be visible in virtual cockpits.
It will be followed like "Score: 12345", as in showing the amounts of points obtained during the mission.

YOU as in the direct or indirect object of an action. As in "Attacking YOU", "Homing in to YOU", "Boarding YOU", "Preparing to attack YOU".
					The word will appear alone in a label, not as part of a sentence.

notes: F as in Fore. One letter that will appear on the virtual cockpits on the Fore Radar Scope.
R as in Rear. One letter that will appear on the virtual cockpits on the Rear Radar Scope.
YOU as in the player ship in the map. Nominative form, an not part of a sentence. It should be a single short expression.
The level of the Pilot Proving Grounds at which the player is currently flying.
As in remaining number of PPG gates yet to be crossed by the player. The number will appear to the right of this label.
As in number of PPG gates wrongfully skipped by the player. The number will appear to the right of this label.
As in number of PPG gates successfully crossed by the player. The number will appear to the right of this label.
As in number of PPG shooting targets that the player has succesfully shot down. The number will appear to the right of this label.
As in number of points scored during this PPG run. The number will appear to the right of this label.
